After the attack is resolved, if it dealt WOUND and the defender is SIZE 3 or less, this character may Throw it SHORT.

superpowers.name: The Best at What I Do...
rules: Action: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. When making this attack, each WILD in the attack roll counts as 2 successes. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superpowers.name: Adamantium Skeleton
rules: When determining if this character can be Thrown or Pushed by an effect or special rule, or when it is colliding with another character or a terrain feature, this character counts as SIZE 3.

superpowers.name: Wild Rage
rules: Add 1 die to this character's attack rolls for each WOUND it has. Additionally, this character cannot interact with or hold objective tokens.

attacks.name: Strike
special_rules: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 POWER.

superpowers.name: Faithful Assistant
rules: Choose another allied character within RANGE 3 of this character. It gains 1 POWER. A character may be affected by this superpower only once per Round.

superpowers.name: Meditate
rules: Action: This character gains 1 POWER.

superpowers.name: The Vishanti's Blessing
rules: Action: This character or an allied character within RANGE 3 of this character removes up to 2 WOUND or 1 special condition. A character may be affected by this superpower only once per Round.

superpowers.name: Servant to the Sorcerer Supreme
rules: While within RANGE 3 of an allied Stephen Vincent Strange, this character adds 1 die to its defense rolls.
